roles.title: Senior Product Manager - Wearable Health Insights

bullets: Vision & Strategy: Own the roadmap for Xealth’s wearable solutions - transitioning from dashboards to AI-enabled insights and real time, data-driven interaction models.
AI-First Development: Identify and bring to market new AI capabilities that leverage EHR, third-party app, and engagement data to improve patient outcomes and clinician…
Customer Focused: You will work with our customer teams as well as external health system relationships that you either bring or develop. Clinical insights are key to success and…
Data-Driven Iteration: Use, and advocate for, data to measure impact and iteratively improve the effectiveness of our tools.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with internal teams (engineering, customer success, partnerships) and external health system customers to launch and scale engagement tools.
